actual_hs_list: 840219 - Steam or other vapour generating boilers (other than central heating hot water boilers capable also of producing low pressure steam); super-heated water boilers: other vapour generating boilers, including hybrid boilers
840310 / 840390 - Central heating boilers and parts (hot water boilers up to 160 C line)
841950 - Heat exchange units (heat exchangers, economisers as heat-exchange equipment)
841989 - Machinery/plant for treatment of materials by a process involving a change of temperature (thermic fluid heaters, waste-heat recovery units, autoclaves, air heaters)
841780 / 841790 - Industrial or laboratory furnaces/ovens incl. incinerators, non-electric, and parts (chimneys/accessories, waste heat boiler ducting - arguable)

product_summary: Website energypackboilers.com (Halol, Dist. Panchmahal, Gujarat works; Mumbai head office) lists: I.B.R. three-pass wet-back horizontal smoke-tube steam boilers EBPL series (oil / gas / solid fuel / agro-waste fired); non-I.B.R. coil-type vertical boilers EPS series; Small Industrial Boiler EPH series (IBR Chapter XIV); hot water boilers (horizontal/vertical three-pass, up to 160 C) incl. pressurised closed-loop; thermic fluid heaters EPT series (oil/gas/coal/briquette/biomass/electrical, waste-heat recovery type); waste heat boilers EPWH series; economisers EPE series; hot air generators / indirect air heaters; boiler automation & monitoring systems (HMI); chimneys per IS 6533; pressure vessels & heat exchangers (autoclaves, digesters, condensers, deaerators, storage tanks); ASME/foundry dewaxing, core leaching and composite autoclaves. Turnkey design-manufacture-erect-commission. Claims CE marking, ISO 9001:2015, IBR approval.
comment: HS 840219 is CORRECT and is the core line: the company is a genuine steam/vapour generating boiler manufacturer (IBR-approved, in-house design and fabrication at Halol). HS 841989 is only PARTIALLY correct - it fits the thermic fluid heaters, waste-heat recovery units, autoclaves and air heaters, but the declaration omits the bulk of the real product range. Missing from the declaration: 840290 (boiler parts), 8403 (hot water boilers), 841950 (heat exchangers/economisers), 841780/841790 (chimneys, furnace-type waste heat equipment), 7326/7309 (custom-fabricated pressure vessels, tanks, deaerators). INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the claimed industry 'IT и электроника' is plainly wrong - this is heavy mechanical/thermal capital equipment (boiler and process-heat engineering), not IT or electronics. No trader signs: own works address, own engineering team, own brand series designations (EBPL/EPS/EPH/EPT/EPE/EPWH) - manufacturer role confirmed. Per project rule 3, the HS/industry mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, declared codes corrected to the actual product mix, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data above is from the company's own website (energypackboilers.com home, /products/, /contact/) - i.e. catalogue claims only; no customs line, shipping bill or B-L record was reviewed in this HS-only pass, therefore every product line here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level. Revenue, export volumes, registries, CIN/PAN and GST turnover were deliberately not researched in this task (out of scope) - null. Note: search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this pass, so no third-party corroboration (IndiaMART, trade directories, buyer references) could be retrieved; the 'Our Clients' page was not readable in the fetched text.
